The KIT Online Application Portal for the B.Sc. program in Mechanical Engineering (International) at the Carl Benz School of Engineering closed on April 30th, 2026.

notes: The tuition fee of €1,500 per semester for non-EU students is taken from the Carl Benz School page, which states it applies to non-EU students. The DAAD page lists a higher fee of €9,201 per semester for non-EU applicants, but this appears to be for the College Programme and may not be the standard tuition; the university page's fee is used. The application deadline is April 30, 2026, as stated on the pages. The applicant is from Morocco, so non-EU rules apply. No translation requirement for documents is stated.

note.fr: Vérifiez les critères d'admission : notes en maths/physique, tests standardisés (SAT 1200, ACT 24, TestAS 75), un an de physique au lycée et lettre de motivation. Seuils de notes à vérifier manuellement.
note.en: Check admission criteria: grades in maths/physics, standardised tests (SAT 1200, ACT 24, TestAS 75), one year of high school physics, and motivation letter. Grade thresholds require manual check.

evidence.quote: The fundamental criteria for admission are excellent grades in mathematics and/or physics (top 80% of class).

One of the following standardised tests: SAT (1,200 points) ACT (24 points) TestAS (percentile rank of 75) One year of high school physics English language proficiency (details below) Motivation letter
